_doc: AI Story script (reddit). This file scaffolds the 7-beat structure. The daily-shorts-pipeline routine fills in 'text', 'keywords', 'title', 'description' fields at production time, then runs check_script_structure.py to lint, then make_audio_elevenlabs.py + build_visuals_track.py.
anti_plagiarism_rule: Reddit posts ARE copyrighted by their authors. The script must REWRITE the story in original prose: different word choices, restructured narrative, anonymized names + locations, paraphrased dialogue. Use the source Reddit post as inspiration only. Verbatim reproduction risks YouTube strike.

beats.label: hook
beats.purpose_hint: AITA question + the outrage in ≤12 words
beats.text: AITA for putting up a fence after my neighbor mowed my lawn?

beats.label: setup
beats.purpose_hint: Who the people are + the relationship
beats.text: I was on vacation for ten days. My retired neighbor across the street decided to do me a favor.

beats.label: build
beats.purpose_hint: What led up to the incident
beats.text: He mowed my entire backyard. Down to the dirt. Said it looked overgrown.

beats.label: mid_anchor
beats.purpose_hint: The twist or escalation that flips audience loyalty
beats.text: Except that wildflower patch was for my daughter's school pollinator project. Three months of growth. Gone.
beats.visual_style_hint: HERO SHOT — reaction face, the moment everything changes

beats.label: expand
beats.text: I put up a privacy fence the next weekend. My wife thinks I overreacted. My neighbor hasn't spoken to me since.

beats.label: payoff
beats.purpose_hint: What I did about it / what the other person did
beats.text: My daughter cried for two days. She wanted to know why a stranger got to decide what was a weed.

beats.label: cta
beats.visual_style_hint: freeze-frame on protagonist, looking at camera

character_continuity_hint: [Characters rotate per video; no cross-video continuity needed. Use generic, anonymized physical descriptions in Flux prompts — do not invoke real Reddit usernames or specific story details.]
description_lead: My neighbor mowed my lawn 'as a favor' and destroyed something he didn't know about.
hook_template: AITA for [inflammatory action]? My [relation] [outrageous thing in 5 words].
spoken_text: AITA for putting up a fence after my neighbor mowed my lawn? I was on vacation for ten days. My retired neighbor across the street decided to do me a favor. He mowed my entire backyard. Down to the dirt. Said it looked overgrown. Except that wildflower patch was for my daughter's school pollinator project. Three months of growth. Gone. I put up a privacy fence the next weekend. My wife thinks I overreacted. My neighbor hasn't spoken to me since. My daughter cried for two days. She wanted to know why a stranger got to decide what was a weed. So. AITA?
title: AITA for fencing my yard?
visual_palette: warm domestic tones, naturalistic lighting, contemporary setting
